extra.question: Which are the top ten withdrawals (non-credit card) by district names for the month of January 1996?
extra.evidence: Non-credit card withdraws refers to type = 'VYDAJ'; January 1996 can be found by date LIKE '1996-01%' in the database; A2 means district names
extra.question_with_evidence: Which are the top ten withdrawals (non-credit card) by district names for the month of January 1996? Hint: Non-credit card withdraws refers to type = 'VYDAJ'; January 1996 can be found by date LIKE '1996-01%' in the database; A2 means district names
extra.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.A2 FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN trans AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T3.type = 'VYDAJ' AND T3.date LIKE '1996-01%' ORDER BY A2 ASC LIMIT 10
